d: Donald Trump is preparing a fresh round of tariffs targeting 14 economies, including India, China, the European Union and Japan. The move comes months after the US Supreme Court struck down his sweeping global tariffs, forcing Washington to find a new legal route. In this video, Firstpost breaks down why the Trump administration is targeting countries over alleged excess industrial capacity, how much different economies could be charged and what the proposals mean for India.
